findings.description: Checkout overview shows an unrounded floating point item total (Item total: $119.94999999999999) for a cart of 5 items; the money value is not formatted to 2 decimals.
repro: Add Backpack, Bolt T-Shirt, Fleece Jacket, Onesie and Red T-Shirt to the cart
Cart > Checkout, fill in name and postal code, Continue

findings.description: Reset App State empties the cart badge but the product tile still shows a 'Remove' button instead of 'Add to cart' until the page is reloaded.
repro: Add Sauce Labs Onesie to cart
Observe the Onesie tile still shows Remove while the badge is gone

findings.description: Checkout can be started and completed with an empty cart; checkout-step-two shows Item total $0 / Total $0.00 and Finish leads to 'Order placed'. /checkout-complete.html is also reachable directly without any order.
repro: Sign in as customer with an empty cart

findings.description: Checkout information form accepts a whitespace-only first name and meaningless postal code ('!!') and proceeds to the overview without validation error.
repro: Add an item, go to Checkout
Enter '   ' as First Name, any Last Name, '!!' as Postal Code

findings.description: Unknown URLs render a completely blank page (no 404 message or navigation) rather than an error page.

notes: Tested login errors, sorting, cart, checkout, detail pages, dynamic catalog pages, menu, mobile viewport. About link goes to external saucelabs.com (unreachable in sandbox). Did not test perf in depth.
